nodes.label: The few things a port cannot say

metadata.comment: Everything else this template styles lives in noodl_modules/dbt-lesson/styles.css (the product's token aliases and the lesson CSS lifted from globals.css) — TASK-L154 §2. This node holds only what needs the document itself.

Mounted HERE, in the root, because a Translation node takes no wire — it reads the module-scoped i18next instance. A bundle loaded inside a page would leave every other page unresolved until someone had visited that one. TASK-L161 §0.

ONE Language Bundle PER NAMESPACE, because its Bundle port parses a JSON string and loads it under exactly one namespace (measured, TASK-L161 §0). Language is pinned to "en": this template ships one locale and the switch is L162's.
